rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for a man who does business or works in commerce.

example.english: My older brother is a businessman and has to travel around all the time.
example.traditional: 我阿哥係生意人，成日要周圍飛。
example.jyutping: ngo5 aa3 go1 hai6 saang1 ji3 jan4 seng4 jat6 jiu3 zau1 wai4 fei1

rows.note: Use this more formal general label for a person engaged in commercial business.

example.english: This businessman has invested in many local projects.
example.traditional: 呢位商人喺本地投資咗好多項目。
example.jyutping: ni1 wai2 soeng1 jan4 hai2 bun2 dei6 tau4 zi1 zo2 hou2 do1 hong6 muk6
